part: Speedrun front splitter (End A), one part, speedrun part designed in this project: the body post mount of the T410R (photos and measurements of the owner) enlarged to the outline of the splitter. It replaces the front foam bumper (the car runs without the bumper).
coordinate_system: Chassis plate coordinates (assembly): x across the car (+x right side seen toward End A), y along the car (End B at y = 0, End A front), z = 0 bottom face of the chassis plate. The part is symmetric to x = 0; the outline points are given for the right half.
design: One part on the holes H34, H35 and H36 at the front end of the chassis plate. The rear part (deck) lies on the top face of the chassis plate; its bottom has a pocket in the form of the front end of the plate (the overhang around the plate holds the part against turning). In front of the plate the part is cranked down by the thickness of the plate, so that its bottom face is flush with the bottom face of the plate; a ramp on the top face follows the front contour of the plate. This front part (front_t) is extended to the outline of the splitter; the body sits on it. Fixing to the chassis plate: 3 countersunk screws M3x6 from below through H34, H35 and H36 into bosses with blind tapped holes (owner). Ears with the hexagon recesses of the original part: press fit of the body posts, each held by a countersunk screw M3x6 from below.

source_codes.plate: Hole pattern and outline of the speedrun chassis plate (chassis_plate_speedrun_wide_motor10_geometry.json)
source_codes.photo: Estimate from the photos of the owner (top view on a ruler, scaled to the distance H34-H35 of the chassis plate)
source_codes.owner: Measurement or information of the owner (measurement sheet front_splitter_measurement_sheet.pdf)
source_codes.assumption: Not measured, assumed for the model
source_codes.design: Design value of the own part

mount_holes.note: Holes of the chassis plate under the part: H34/H35 (x = +-16.677, y = 317.982) and H36 (x = -0.114, y = 321.224), each under a boss. The part is screwed to the chassis plate with countersunk screws M3x6 from below through all 3 holes (owner).

mount_rear_y.note: Straight rear edge of the mount: 4.0 behind the centres of H34/H35 (M4). The outer pivot block at End A ends at y = 309.45.

mount_outline.note: Outline of the right half from the rear corner to the centre line at the front edge: form from the top view photo, scaled to the measurements of the owner: width over the ears 79.5 (M1), width over the side lips 47.7 (M6), rear edge 4.0 behind H34/H35 (M4), depth on the centre line 19.2 (M5). The side lips wrap around the side edges of the chassis plate (x = 21.33).

pocket_clearance.note: Gap between the pocket (overhang) of the mount and the front contour of the chassis plate, all around.

deck_t.note: Thickness of the deck on the chassis plate: total height at the rear edge 4.5 (M7) minus the depth of the pocket 2.0 (M9). Top face of the deck at z = 4.5.

front_t.note: Thickness of the part in front of the chassis plate (M8; bottom face flush with the bottom face of the plate, M9).

ramp_w.note: Width (top view) of the ramp on the top face from the deck down to the front part; it follows the front contour of the plate (M10, not measured).

collar.note: Diameter of the bosses on H34, H35 and H36: as the collar of the original part (M11). The bosses reach from the deck up to the top given in one_piece.

screws.note: Countersunk screws M3x6 from below through H34, H35 and H36 (owner): tip 6.0 above the bottom face of the chassis plate (head in the countersink of the plate); tap drill M3.

screw_hole_d.note: Through holes for the screws M3 (M11, M16).

ear_holes.note: Position of the holes in the ears (right ear; left ear mirrored): distance 65.6 across the car (M2), 12.0 ahead of H34/H35 (M3). Positions of the body posts.

ear_boss.note: Boss of the ears: diameter (photo, scaled), height of the top of the original boss above the bottom face (M15), hexagon recess across flats (press fit of the body post, M13) and its depth in the original boss (M16): bottom of the recess at 4.41 - 2.1 = 2.31, the body post keeps this position and its screw M3x6 from below. The boss of the own part is as the original part; the recess reaches from 2.31 to its top.

ear_csk.note: Countersink (90 degrees) on the bottom face of the ear holes for the countersunk screws M3x6 that hold the body posts (M13).

body_post.note: Body posts (stock parts, assembly only): diameter (M13), length of the hexagon section from the bottom of the recess (M13, 2.31 above the bottom face; hexagon across flats as the recess), length of the round post above the hexagon section (assumed, B6), bore (thread M3 of the screw M3x6 from below).

test_print.note: Test print for a home 3D printer (the whole part does not fit on the print bed, owner): the middle part over the chassis plate and the ears, cut out with a rectangle: half width (the mount is 79.5 wide), y from the rear edge to 7.6 ahead of the front end of the mount; bottom face on the print bed.

splitter_rear_outline.note: Rear edge of the splitter, right half: vertices (x, y, fillet radius); variant C of the design suggestions (owner): straight rear edge from -38 to 38 at y = 313 (1.0 behind the rear edge of the mount), then concave rear edges, deeper beside the mount and narrower toward the tips. The splitter needs its full width only at the front, where it closes the space between the chassis front and the body. Clear of the front tyres at full steering lock (see the check).

splitter_front_distance.note: Front end of the splitter on the centre line: 90 ahead of the axis through the centres of the holes H34/H35 (y = 317.982 + 90 = 407.982).

front_form_offset.note: The front edge of the splitter is the polyline front_form, offset outward by this distance and moved forward until its front end lies at splitter_front_distance.

splitter_front_radii.note: Fillet radii of the outer form at the offset points of body_front_edge, from the tip (last point) to the centre line (first point). The outer form lies at most 0.7 inside the exact offset.

front_form.note: Form of the front edge of the splitter, right half, (x, y): the form of the lower front edge of the body (ZooRacing Hellcat), assumed (not measured): flat in the middle, receding toward the corners. Used with front_form_offset and splitter_front_distance; the outer form of the splitter follows the body (owner).

body_overhang.note: The body sits on the splitter; the splitter shows 15 to 20 ahead of the lower front edge of the body (owner). Model: the lower front edge of the body lies 17.5 (mean) behind the front edge of the splitter (normal offset of the outer form): on the centre line 72.5 ahead of the axis H34-H35. To be checked on the car (B1 to B4).

one_piece.note: The body post mount is enlarged to the outline of the splitter (one part); the splitter area has the thickness of the front part of the mount (front_t, bottom face flush with the chassis plate). Values: depth of the blind tapped holes M3 on H34, H35 and H36 beyond the tip of the screws M3x6 from below, density of the print material (PETG) for the mass, top of the bosses on H34, H35 and H36 (diameter: collar; the screws are not visible from above, owner). 3D print of the owner: with the top at 7.0 (0.5 above the blind holes) the tightened screw M3x6 broke through the top of the bosses; the bosses are 3.0 higher (owner), 3.5 of material above the holes. Owner (2026-11-27): the bosses are 1.0 higher again (top at 11.0, 4.5 of material above the holes).

tyre_check.note: Check of the clearance to the front tyres: tyre width (spec_tires.yaml, setup sheet 4: 30), droop of the wheel below the static ride height (assumption), required clearance, steering angle checked in both directions (the free angle of the knuckle is approx. 30 toward the middle and 45 toward the outside; required: 25). Tyre as a cylinder of radius wheel_r on the wheel centre plane wheel_centre_x (running_gear_parameters.json).
